question.text: An object with mass 500 g moves along x -axis with speed $v=4 \sqrt{x} \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$. The force acting on the object is :

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & F=M \times a \\ & v=4 \sqrt{x} \\ & v^2=16 x \\ & 2 v \frac{d v}{d x}=16 \\ & \frac{v d v}{d x}=\frac{16}{2}=8 \\ & F=0.5 \times 8=4 N\end{aligned}$
